readings.basis: The statement's project name 'dự án Thủy điện tích năng Bắc Ái' translates to 'Bac Ai pumped-storage hydropower plant', matching the canonical name of the existing identity. The sector (pumped-storage hydropower) and country (VNM) also align. The spelling difference ('Bắc Ái' vs 'Bac Ai') is a Vietnamese diacritic variation and does not affect identity.

The statement's label 'dự án Thủy điện tích năng Bắc Ái' is the direct Vietnamese translation of the existing identity's canonical name 'Bac Ai pumped-storage hydropower plant'. Both refer to a pumped-storage hydropower project at Bac Ai. The spelling difference is only due to language (Vietnamese vs. English) and does not indicate a different project. The statement's status ('đang trong giai đoạn đàm phán thỏa thuận vốn' / 'in the stage of negotiating capital agreement') is consistent with the existing identity's record of a term sheet and financier updates.
